not_observable.case: tests/integration/test_tracker_cli.py::test_tracker_sync_runs_now and test_tracker_sync_queue_returns_job_id: running a sync now (with or without --full) reads issues from Jira and reports fetched, created and updated counts, which needs a fake Jira the runner cannot reach

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_creates_tasks_projects_and_external_items: a sync creates tasks, projects, external items and task.synced events from fetched Jira issues, which needs a fake Jira the runner cannot start

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_update_writes_only_changed_fields: a second sync after a Jira edit writes only the changed fields and the task.updated changes, which needs a fake Jira the runner cannot start

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_unchanged_issue_emits_no_event: re-syncing an unchanged issue reports it unchanged and emits no task.synced event, which needs a fake Jira the runner cannot start

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_child_is_applied_after_its_parent_and_blocker: a child issue listed before its parent and blocker is applied after them, with parent and dependency links, which needs a fake Jira the runner cannot start

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_missing_parent_is_fetched_before_the_write: a parent outside the cursor window is fetched directly by key before the child is written, which needs a fake Jira the runner cannot start

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_parent_outside_configured_projects_is_not_fetched: a parent or blocker outside the configured projects is not fetched and leaves no parent link, which needs a fake Jira the runner cannot start

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_removed_blocker_drops_the_sync_dependency: removing a blocker in Jira drops the sync-created dependency and emits task.dependency_removed, which needs a fake Jira the runner cannot start

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_pull_requests_link_resolved_and_unresolved_repositories: pull requests from issue fields and dev panels link to registered repositories or are reported unresolved, which needs a fake Jira and a registered repository the runner cannot set up

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_done_issues_are_accepted_or_cancelled: Jira done issues map to accepted or cancelled by resolution, and in-progress issues to backlog, which needs a fake Jira the runner cannot start

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_cursor_advances_and_the_next_search_overlaps: the sync cursor advances to the newest updated time and the next search starts with an overlap window, which needs a fake Jira and the cursor value from a real sync

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_full_reconcile_marks_then_archives_after_grace: full syncs mark issues missing and archive them only after the grace period, using an injected clock, which the runner cannot drive

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_dev_panel_failure_is_recorded_and_sync_continues: a failing dev panel request is recorded in the sync errors while the sync still creates the tasks, which needs a fake Jira that can be told to fail

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_search_error_closes_client_and_keeps_applied_pages: a Jira search failure mid-page closes the client, keeps the already applied pages and does not advance the cursor past them, which needs a fake Jira that fails mid-search

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_no_write_transaction_is_open_during_client_calls: no database write transaction is open while the sync calls the tracker client, which needs in-process session instrumentation the runner cannot attach

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_moved_issue_changes_the_task_key: an issue moved to a new key keeps its task and external id and records a task.updated key change, which needs a fake Jira that can move an issue

tests/integration/test_tracker_sync.py::test_sync_report_is_serialisable: a full sync report serialises with full, created and cursor fields, which needs a real sync to produce a report the CLI does not print in the queue form
